7.6 Recovery actions
The scope of
Platform Health Management
is to monitor the safety relevant
Pro-
cesses
on the platform and report detect failures to State Management. If a failure in
State Management is detected,
Platform Health Management
can trigger a reac-
tion via hardware watchdog.
